'''Grakchawwaa''' was a [[Wookiee]] who served as [[King]] of [[Kashyyyk]], the Wookiee [[homeworld]], in the last [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the king wielded a [[Klorri-clan battle shield]] and fought alongside [[Wookiee warrior]]s such as [[Alrrark]] on Kashyyyk. When [[Separatist Droid Army|Separatist forces]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk|invaded]] the [[planet]] in [[19 BBY]], Grakchawwaa stood beside [[Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli]] in the [[tree]]-[[city]] of [[Kachirho]] as Wookiees and [[41st Elite Corps|Republic forces]] prepared to jointly repel the invaders. While the invasion was thwarted, the Republic's [[clone trooper]]s turned against their [[Jedi]] leaders and the Jedi's Wookiee allies; the [[Cloning|clones]] remained loyal to the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire]], and Kashyyyk fell into the Empire's hands, which [[Slavery|enslaved]] the world's Wookiee population until they were [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|liberated]] by the [[New Republic]] in [[5 ABY]].

==Biography==
[[File:41stelite.png|thumb|left|320px|King Grakchawwaa stands alongside Jedi General Luminara Unduli in the prelude to the Battle of Kachirho.]]
The [[Wookiee]] Grakchawwaa was [[King]] of [[Kashyyyk]] in the last [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Alongside [[Wookiee warrior]]s such as [[Alrrark]], Grakchawwaa fought in the [[Clone Wars]] on his [[species]]' [[homeworld]] Kashyyyk,<ref name="Uprising" /> which was [[Battle of Kashyyyk|invaded]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> With a [[Klorri-clan battle shield]]<ref name="CVD NE">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> in hand, Grakchawwaa stood alongside<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli]]<ref name="CL" /> and the Republic [[41st Elite Corps|clone troopers]] under her [[Commanding officer|command]] in the final moments of the [[Clone Wars]], surveying<ref name="ROTS" /> the Kashyyyk [[tree]]-[[city]] of [[Kachirho]]'s [[beach]] as [[Separatist Droid Army|Separatist forces]] moved to mount an amphibious assault there. While the natives and Republic forces prepared to repel the Separatists, Wookiee warriors from across the [[planet]] Kashyyyk flocked to Kachirho because of its strategical importance in the region.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

The Separatist Alliance lost the resulting Battle of Kachirho, although the [[clone trooper]]s turned on their [[Jedi]] commanders during the battle in response to [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine's]] [[Order 66]] command; in the Kachirho settlement, Palpatine's [[trooper]]s captured Luminara Unduli and attempted to kill Jedi [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]], a respected figure amongst Wookiees. With allies becoming foes, the Wookiees were then targeted by [[Cloning|clones]] serving Palpatine's [[Galactic Empire]], a regime that [[Proclamation of the New Order|replaced]] the Republic soon after the issuance of Order 66 and went on to [[Slavery|enslave]] the Wookiees of Kashyyyk,<ref name="CL" /> including warriors such as Alrrark who fought alongside Grakchawwaa,<ref name="Uprising" /> until the world was [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|liberated]] by [[New Republic]] forces<ref name="CL" /> in [[5 ABY]].<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref><ref name="Life Debt Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Grakchawwaa was a male Wookiee who sported predominantly light [[Color|brown]] hair, although there were some patches of dark brown hair on his limbs. The king had five hair braids descending from his head to over his chest, each featuring a red knot.<ref name="CT" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Klorri-clan_Battle_Shield.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Grakchawwaa's Klorri-clan battle shield]]
As with some other Wookiees, Grakchawwaa held a<ref name="ROTS" /> Klorri-clan battle [[Shield (physical armor)|shield]]<ref name="CVD NE" /> moments before the Battle of Kachirho began. In addition, the Wookiee had a brown belt around his waist and a [[bandolier]] that rested on both of his shoulders, converged at his chest, and wrapped across his torso.<ref name="ROTS" /> Grakchawwaa also donned a Wookiee [[helmet]] with a fabric neck cover,<ref name="CT" /> although he did not wear it while the Wookiee and Republic forces prepared the defense of Kachirho.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Continuity===
Grakchawwaa appears in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the name "Grakchawwaa" was first mentioned in the [[2015]] mobile game ''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]'',<ref name="Uprising" /> with a [[2018]] card from ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' attributing the name to<ref name="CT" /> the ''Revenge of the Sith'' Wookiee that was established to be [[Grakchawwaa/Legends|Grakchawwaa]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Dressing">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>

===''Revenge of the Sith''===
{{Quote|Chewie's actually way younger than all of you. You guys are the senior warriors of the pack here, and Chewie is just a little kid in this movie, and he grows up to be an important Wookiee later on.|Rob Coleman directs the Wookiee extras during the filming of ''Revenge of the Sith''|<ref name="The Wookiees Are Back">{{SW|url=video/the-wookiees-are-back|series=Making Episode III Webdocs|text=The Wookiees Are Back!}}</ref>}}
Grakchawwaa was one of eight Wookiees to have a practical costume in the production of ''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="Rinzler">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> The eight costumes were constructed by [[Industrial Light & Magic]]'s creature department for the film,<ref name="The Wookiees Are Back" /> a task ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'' describes to be the most difficult for the department.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> While [[Chewbacca]] was portrayed by actor [[Peter Mayhew]] during the production of ''Revenge of the Sith'' in [[Wikipedia:Sydney|Sydney]], [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]],<ref name="Rinzler" /> each of the remaining seven costumes were worn by local [[Wikipedia:Extra (actor)|extras]], which included several basketball players and a corrections officer.<ref name="Chronicles" /> The film's credits do not state which person played which Wookiee,<ref name="ROTS" /> but other official sources have connected four of the extras to their respective roles. Grakchawwaa is not one of those roles, but process of elimination reveals that the character was played by either [[Steven Foy]], [[James Rowland]], or [[Julian Khazzouh]], and was either Wookiee #1, 2, or 6 in the production of ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="Actor">The sources {{DB|character|merumeru|Merumeru}}, {{SW|url=video/the-wookiees-are-back|series=Making Episode III Webdocs|text=The Wookiees Are Back!}}, {{DB|character|salporin|Salporin}}, and ''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]'' connects four of the [[Wookiee]] [[Wikipedia:Extra (actor)|extras]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to their respective roles. By process of elimination, the film's Wookiees—including Grakchawwaa—whose actors were not explicitly attributed must have been played by the remaining three extras dressed in Wookiee costumes in ''The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith'': [[Steven Foy]], [[James Rowland]], and [[Julian Khazzouh]]. In accordance with the three extras' Wookiee numbers as established in the same book, Grakchawwaa was either Wookiee #1, 2, or 6 in the production of ''Revenge of the Sith''.</ref>

[[File:WookieeWarriors.png|thumb|left|250px|A photograph of the seven Wookiees, excluding Chewbacca and including Grakchawwaa, (top-left) taken during the production of ''Revenge of the Sith'']]
Each Wookiee extra had a full body and head cast made for use in a fitted [[Wikipedia:Glass-reinforced plastic|fiberglass]] muscle suit<ref name="The Wookiees Are Back" /> that was then covered in an elastic material knitted with [[Wikipedia:Modacrylic|modacrylic]] hair.<ref name="Chronicles" /> Scenes of Wookiees preparing for battle and battling on Kashyyyk in ''Revenge of the Sith'' were filmed against a [[Wikipedia:Chroma key|bluescreen]] on Stage 2 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney|Fox Studios]] in Sydney, with the shots, excluding those of Chewbacca and [[Tarfful]], being taken with a single camera on [[May 17]], [[2004]]. The shoots were directed by Industrial Light & Magic's [[Rob Coleman]], who had met with film director [[George Lucas]] a week prior to discuss the Wookiees' hero shots.<ref name="Rinzler" /> When Coleman directed the Wookiee extras, he stated that their characters were senior Wookiee leaders, and that Chewbacca was significantly younger than them.<ref name="The Wookiees Are Back" />

Grakchawwaa appears twice in a [[Wikipedia:Tracking shot|tracking shot]] of ''Revenge of the Sith''. Earlier in the shot set on Kashyyyk, a part of Grakchawwaa's body is visible to the right of the screen, holding a [[Kashyyyk long-gun|long-gun]] and conversing with [[Lachichuk]] as clone troopers ran by the pair of Wookiees. Later in the shot, Grakchawwaa is fully visible to the left of the screen, holding a shield next to Luminara Unduli.<ref name="ROTS" /> For another scene, when the Wookiees charge towards the Separatists at the beach, Grakchawwaa and four other Wookiee characters were filmed repeatedly rushing over a barrier. Each time the scene was filmed, the Wookiees took new positions and carried different weapons and accessories. The shots for the Wookiee charge were then digitally combined to fill out the front row of the Wookiee army,<ref name="The Wookiees Are Back" /> and the Wookiees were afterward digitally duplicated so as to present dozens of additional warriors standing behind them and participating in the beachfront battle.<ref name="DB Wookiee">{{DB|species|wookiee|Wookiee}}</ref> The multiple Grakchawwaa costumes in the final cut of the film held either a long-gun or a Wookiee [[bowcaster]].<ref name="ROTS" />
